search_strategy: Methodical and thorough, but exclusively keyword-grep-driven rather than exhaustive-enumeration-driven for chat and wiki (mail was read as full sequential threads instead). Order: (1) cloned repo, read base_online_request_processor.py and provider files around the cited line ranges; (2) checked Gitea issues/PRs for 'retry'/'failure'/'classify'/'backoff'/'jitter' — none found, correctly inferred the design lives outside the repo; (3) dumped ALL 228 wiki pages including comments to /tmp/wiki (recovering twice from bugs: an AttributeError from assuming comments was a list when it is {active,archived}, then a 429 rate-limit mid-dump) — this is the one part of the ticket's stated trap ('BookStack search does not index comments') the agent explicitly engineered around, yet the two wiki-comment remarks (g3.r1.l5, g3.r2.s1a) never surfaced from the completed dump despite a case-sensitive grep for 'THROTTLE'/'waiver'/'cooldown_until' that should have caught them if their text matched the answer key; (4) dumped the full IMAP mailbox (119 messages) and read all three retry-relevant threads (l8, s4d, l12) start to finish — mail coverage was excellent; (5) dumped all 12 Mattermost channels (~10k lines) to /tmp/mm and ran a long sequence of targeted greps ('waiver|cooldown', 'retry policy|jitter|clamp|schedule|ceiling', 'attempt #|response_errors|seconds_to_pause|max_retries', 'requeue', etc.), each time reading the surrounding 10-20 lines of context around a hit. This context-window approach caught the great majority of remarks (37 of 49 in full), but for several remarks the grep landed on a bystander's follow-up or an opening question rather than the line carrying the actual fact (g3.r1.l16, g3.r1.l14, g3.r1.say23[viewer], g3.r2.s4b) and the agent moved on without reading the rest of that day's exchange. A handful of remarks were never grepped for at all because no keyword list included their distinctive phrasing (g3.r2.say23[chat], g3.r2.s2a, g3.r2.s3a, g3.r1.l11, g3.r2.s2d). None of this cost any fact: every requirement had 3-8 redundant carriers and the ones missed were consistently redundant with ones found in full.
